name: CiteBrand
description: Measures whether AI engines name and link a brand for buyer questions, per lane (assistants, AI apps, search-page AI), with sample sizes, sources and resolvable evidence for every claim; returns evidence-cited plans and monitors change week over week.

skills.name: Measure AI visibility
skills.description: Ask AI engines buyer questions and report, per lane and engine, how often the brand is named and linked, with n, source and evidence ids. Async: a job, then GET visibility.
examples: How often does ChatGPT mention peec.ai for "best AI visibility tools"?
Measure otterly.ai on Google AI and the ChatGPT app with these 5 questions.

skills.name: Evidence-cited plan
skills.description: Ranked recommendations (page, exact change, evidence, how to measure) and publishable deliverables for a measured brand. Reading is open to keys that verified the domain; writing a plan is operator-only in v1.
examples: What should otterly.ai change to be cited for pricing questions?

skills.name: Off-site: outreach, mentions, proof
skills.description: Who to ask for a link (domains linking to competitors but not to you, domains AI answers cite, pages naming you without a link), what news, blogs and forums say about the brand, and dated screenshots of the Google results behind the answers.
examples: Which sites should otterly.ai pitch for a link?
Show me what Google showed for "best AI visibility tools".

skills.name: Make a site agent-ready
skills.description: Verified facts quoted from a brand's own pages, a WebMCP site kit that registers read-only tools from them, a hosted public facts document, a check that a site's facts file is signed by the key its owner publishes (verify_facts, no key), and a verification visit by CiteBrand's agent.
examples: What does otterly.ai charge, with the source?
Give me the site kit for otterly.ai.

skills.name: Monitor weekly
skills.description: Re-measure weekly with the same questions and engines, compare with the previous run (shared questions and engines only), and deliver job events by signed webhook.
examples: Re-measure peec.ai every week and tell me when it changes.

x-citebrand.note: This card describes CiteBrand's skills for orchestrators. The A2A message protocol (message/send) is not served in v1: call the MCP server or the REST API listed under additionalInterfaces.
